releases.body:
## What's new

- Per-currency usage windows in magpie's panel: plan credits (subscription), API balance (recharged USD) and daily DIEM each get their own wallet window, ordered by Venice's charge order, with the DIEM epoch reset time on the DIEM window.
- Optional plan-credit progress estimate: set your plan tier once via `magpie plugin options` (`{"plan":"pro"|"plus"|"max"}`) and the plan-credits window becomes an estimate with a used percentage (official monthly allowances: Pro 1 / Plus 75 / Max 225 credits).
- Billing order documented in the README: Venice charges DIEM, then earned credits, then bundled credits, then USD, automatically continuing on USD when bundled credits run out — no switch needed.
- Rate-limit summary windows and error handling are unchanged.

## Breaking

- The top-level `balance` string in the usage report is removed in favor of the per-currency wallet windows (affects `magpie quota --json` readers).

Initial release of opencode-venice-auth — a magpie / OpenCode v1 provider plugin for Venice.ai.

- Sign in with a Venice API key (authorize validates via /api_keys/rate_limits)
- Dynamic text-model list from GET /models?type=text (offline/beta/deprecated/e2ee/non-tool-call filtered; nested OpenCode Model shape)
- Chat via OpenAI-compatible endpoint, streaming passthrough
- Usage display: balances, key expiry, per-type rate-limit summaries
- CI: bun test + tsc + pluvy gate; release publishing via npm staged publishing (maintainer approves with 2FA)
